listingTitle: Keep behavior with the data it uses
title: Keep behavior with the data it uses
why: A method dominated by one parameter’s members may own misplaced behavior.
suggestion: Consider moving the behavior to the foreign type or its API.
limitations: Requires five accesses across three members and sixty percent of received accesses; Dart direct and null-aware accesses contribute to that denominator, while parameters matching the enclosing class type, AST visitor implementations, and accesses solely composing a returned Flutter Widget are excluded.
Comments, strings, generated, test, example, and vendored sources follow normal analysis classification and suppression controls.
